subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: For an accepted gateway run whose connection drops non-transiently, should this PR preserve recook-first recovery on a fresh session, or should it implement reattach-first recovery from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 before landing?
rationale: Both choices are technically viable but differ in duplicate side effects, delivery behavior, terminal streaming, and result authority; repository policy treats fallback behavior as an explicit product choice.

options.title: Approve focused recook-first fix
options.body: Repair the import cycle and merge fresh-session isolation now, leaving reattach-first recovery as separately tracked product work.

options.title: Expand to reattach-first
options.body: Use the accepted run ID to recover the authoritative gateway result before allowing fresh-session embedded fallback as a last resort.

options.title: Pause pending recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers settle one recovery policy covering accepted disconnects and gateway timeouts.

recommendation.title: Approve focused recook-first fix
recommendation.body: Repair the import cycle and merge fresh-session isolation now, leaving reattach-first recovery as separately tracked product work.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available history-backed candidate for deciding agent-runtime fallback behavior and its user-visible tradeoffs.
